spans.s: pauraṃdara, a. (ī) belonging or relating 🞄to Puraṃdara, i. e. Indra.

paurava, a. (ī) belonging to or descended 🞄from Pūru;
 m. descendant of Pūru: 🞄pl. race of Pūru.
paura-sakhya, n. friendship or 🞄equality of fellow-citizens.
pauras-tya, a. situated in front 🞄(puras), foremost: pl. the eastern people (= 🞄the Gauḍas): -pavana, m. east wind.

paura‿agra-gaṇya, m. chief of 🞄the city;
 -aṅganā, f. woman of the town, 🞄female citizen.

paurāṇa, a. (ī) relating to past 🞄ages, ancient: i-ka, a. (ī) id.;
 versed in 🞄ancient story.

pauruṣ-ya, a. relating to Puruṣa;
 🞄n. manly deed, valour.
pauru-hūta, a. relating to Puruhūta 🞄or Indra.
paurt-ika, a. relating to a charitable 🞄or meritorious work.

paurva‿apar-ya, n. relation between 🞄prior and posterior, succession;
 -ahṇ-ika, a. 🞄(ī) relating to the forenoon.
